ValidationRule.description: An opportunity cannot be Closed Won (leased) without a tenant name and a lease start date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Closed Won" ), OR( ISBLANK( Tenant_Name__c ), ISBLANK( Lease_Start_Date__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To mark this lease as Closed Won, enter a Tenant Name and a Lease Start Date.
